scares.description: A shark lunges at the camera.
A dolphin jumps out of the water in front of Nancy.
The shark grabs Nancy and pulls her underwater as she tries to get back on her surfboard.
The shark leaps out of the water and grabs a surfer.
A broken surfboard pops out of the water in front of Nancy.
A man tries to climb onto the rock that Nancy is stranded on.
Nancy turns around to see the shark leap out of the water and attempt to bite her.
The shark bites the buoy from underneath the water.
